---
title: Vitest
description: Run Vitest Browser Mode against an existing Chrome through fastcdp
---

```{python}
#| echo: false
import re
from IPython.display import Markdown, display
from nbdev.showdoc import show_doc
import fastcdp.vitest as mod
from fastcdp.vitest import Vitest, bridge_main

body = re.sub(r'\n+Docs:\s*\S+\s*$', '', '\n\n'.join((mod.__doc__ or '').split('\n\n')[1:]).strip())
if body: display(Markdown(body))
for sym in (Vitest, Vitest.run, Vitest.close, bridge_main): display(show_doc(sym))
```
